updates.content:
Title: Users may not see Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) contact names shown on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners

User impact: Users may not see Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) contact names shown on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners.

More info: Affected users report that they expect to see saved contact names displayed on inbound PSTN Teams call banners. Calls can still be received and answered. The saved contact name may appear after answering or in call history. Internal Teams calls aren’t reported as affected.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with names not appearing in incoming call banners in Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may not see Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) contact names shown on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners

User impact: Users may not see Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) contact names shown on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners.

More info: Affected users report that they expect to see saved contact names displayed on inbound PSTN Teams call banners. Calls can still be received and answered. The saved contact name may appear after answering or in call history. Internal Teams calls aren’t reported as affected.

Current status: We've determined that a recent change introduced an incorrect configuration affecting how PSTN contact names are displayed for inbound Microsoft Teams calls. We're developing a fix to correct this configuration and expect it to deploy by our next communication update.

Scope of impact: This event may impact any user expecting to see PSTN contact names on inbound Microsoft Teams call banners. This section may be updated as our investigation progresses.

Start time: Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 8:30 PM UTC

Root cause: A recent change introduced an incorrect configuration within how PSTN contact names are displayed for inbound Teams calls, which is resulting in impact.

Next update by: Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 7:00 PM UTC
